Check to see if you need to add explicit handling for NA here...
x + NaN will be correctly evaluated to NaN on the processor-level, but you
may loose the signaling bit that distinguishes between NA and NaN on some
platforms. (behavior is governed at the processor level, not the jvm, so is
platform dependent :-( )
